rationale: 835 denies both lines CO-29 (timely filing) with N211. But the 277CA proves the claim was received and accepted for adjudication on 2025-01-27 — only 8 days after DOS 2025-01-19. This is well within any commercial filing limit. Payer is CI (commercial), not Medicare, so N211 carries no statutory appeal bar. The clearinghouse acceptance report is proof of timely filing; appeal disputing the payer's receipt-date determination.

root_cause.explanation: Payer denied CO-29 but 277CA shows claim accepted for adjudication 2025-01-27, 8 days after DOS 2025-01-19. Filing was timely; payer's receipt-date determination is incorrect.

next_action.detail: Appeal to Liberty Bell with 277CA acceptance report (received 2025-01-27, status A2, code 20) as proof of timely filing. Dispute the receipt date — do not plead forgiveness.
